title: m3a re-import record (_import.json)
description: What `npm run import` chose for each clip of a set re-imported from its sources (PLAN.md WP-5.3, D63): its re-import or its migrated version, and why; both fits, both QA verdicts, the metrics that moved and the hands' error; the catalog's skips and the clips gone.

mean.description: the set's mean fit against its sources (mm), as kept

props.description: the hands' mean error from the pelvis on the clips that hold something (mm): migrated, and as kept; null with none

kept.description: adopted: the owner adopted an improvement from the intake queue (WP-9.1), kept over the version its source gives; the measures beside it are its source's

read.description: the clip's verdict as written, its contacts by the reading `contacts` names (D129); import and migrated are the versions' before it

hands.description: [re-import] for a new clip, else [migrated, re-import] (mm)

repaired.description: the sensors' fix steps the re-import was repaired with (WP-5.8)

unrepairedFit.description: the re-import's fit before its repair (mean, worst mm)

unrepaired.description: why a re-import the sensors flag wasn't repaired: no step makes it better, or how much further from its source the repair would take it (WP-5.8)

contacts.description: the reading of core's (clip.CONTACT_READINGS) its contacts are written by, labelled, as its set's import spec names it (D129)
